rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; f1040sb (2025) p.1 line4 says to subtract line3 from line2. Within the admitted scope, savings-bond exclusion is refused and line3 is the zero-dollar parameter; line2 sums NonNegDollars interest entries. The returned subtract_floor0 therefore never binds, and equals the project subtraction on all admitted values. Both preserve the required Dollars result type. This does not admit the excluded bond-exclusion regime.
